issue_context.title: support explain format = 'test' for fewer meaningless test updates
issue_context.body:
## Development Task

Currently, if we change optimizer code, there may be a lot of tests to be updated because of the change of the ID for each planner operator. These trivial updates can be avoided if we use a new syntax `explain format = 'test'`(just for test purpose, so there is no compatibility concern) to stop printing the ID in the explain output.

review_comments: This is the main code change of this PR.
